item.title: How to Get the Values of an Object in JavaScript
item.description: Extracting values from JavaScript objects is a fundamental task when processing data from APIs or user input. As the creator of CoreUI, I frequently work with object value extraction in UI components. The most efficient and modern approach is using the Object.values() method, which returns an array of all enumerable property values.
